task.title: Manage organizations, entitlements and readers
task.shortdesc: An organization's entitlements decide what its readers see. Load them from a seed file, or change them through the admin API.

ul.li: An organization has a slug and a name.
Its entitlements are the products and features it holds and the version it runs, exactly the fields of a preview context. Without entitlements, its readers see "No access yet".
A reader belongs to one organization and is identified by email. Sign-in links the email to the identity provider's account the first time.

stepxmp.codeblock:
repos: - fullName: acme/docs # owner/name as GitHub sends it sourceUrl: https://github.com/acme/docs.git # installationId: 12345678 # GitHub App installation, for private repos releaseRefs: [main, 'v*'] # branches and tags that publish (default [main]) docsPath: . # docs root inside the repository (default .)
orgs: - slug: acme name: Acme Corp entitlements: products: [core] features: [] version: '0.1' # picks the 0.x docs readers: [ann@acme.example] - slug: globex name: Globex entitlements: products: [hosted, embed] version: '0.1' readers: - email: gus@globex.example name: Gus

step.cmd: Load it with the seed command.

stepxmp.codeblock: opend-server seed /seed/seed.yaml # with Docker Compose: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml run --rm migrate seed /seed/seed.yaml

info.p: Everything is upserted in one transaction, so the file can be applied again after each change. Seeding never deletes anything.

step.cmd: For day-to-day changes, use the admin API.

stepxmp.codeblock: H="authorization: Bearer $OPEND_ADMIN_TOKEN" # Change what an organization may see curl -X PUT "$PUBLIC_URL/admin/api/orgs/acme/entitlements" -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' \ -d '{"products":["core","embed"],"features":[],"version":"0.1"}' # Add a reader, or move one to another organization curl -X POST "$PUBLIC_URL/admin/api/readers" -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' \ -d '{"orgSlug":"acme","email":"bo@acme.example","name":"Bo"}'

result.p: Entitlement changes take effect at once on every replica: the server is notified through Postgres and clears its caches. Every change through the API or a seed is written to the audit log. Values are tokens (letters, digits, _, ., :, -), and the version is a version number such as 0.1. Use the same product and feature values the docs declare in opend.config.yaml.
